topic.name: 中国与世界
topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: China breakthrough projected to put sustainable aviation fuel gross profit margin past 50%
items.summary: Chinese researchers have developed a catalyst that converts synthesis gas into sustainable jet fuel – an advance that could boost production, help meet net-zero carbon goals and yield a gross profit margin above 50 per cent. The team verified the efficacy of the chemical catalyst in a thousand-tonne pilot test and found that combining woody biomass-derived synthesis gas, or syngas, with the cobalt-manganese catalyst enabled the “highly efficient synthesis of jet fuel”. Based on a techno-economic...
items.titleZh: 中国取得技术突破，可持续航空燃料毛利率有望超过50%
items.summaryZh: 中国研究人员开发出一种新型催化剂，可将合成气高效转化为可持续航空燃料。在千吨级中试中，该技术展现了极高的转化效率，预计将大幅提升生产利润并助力实现净零排放目标。
items.whyImportant: 该技术突破有望降低可持续航空燃料的生产成本，对航空业的绿色转型具有重要意义。

items.title: Spirit of Hong Kong Awards: youth-led charity supports young cancer patients
items.summary: Timothy Chan Chi-fung was 19 when a testicular tumour sent him into a Hong Kong hospital system largely designed for children or much older adults. Neither door quite fitted. His experience eventually led him to found Youth Cancer Hong Kong, a contribution that has earned him a place as a finalist in the community category of this year’s Spirit of Hong Kong Awards. The awards, co-organised by Sino Group and the South China Morning Post, were launched in 2013 to recognise individuals and...
items.titleZh: 香港精神奖：青年主导的慈善机构支持年轻癌症患者
items.summaryZh: 陈志峰因自身患癌经历，创办了“香港青年癌症基金”，旨在填补针对年轻癌症患者的医疗支持空白。他凭借此贡献入围了本年度“香港精神奖”社区组别决赛。
items.whyImportant: 该奖项表彰了个人在改善社会服务和关注弱势群体方面的积极贡献。

items.title: Hong Kong to deploy extra manpower for Huanggang Port opening on Monday
items.summary: The revamped Huanggang border crossing between Hong Kong and Shenzhen will open on Monday, with extra manpower deployed and high-level command centres activated to ensure a smooth opening. Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung said on Friday that his bureau would activate its Emergency Monitoring and Support Centre to oversee operations, while a joint command centre will be established with Shenzhen authorities. “We will monitor passenger and vehicle flows as well as surrounding traffic...
items.titleZh: 香港将为周一启用的皇岗口岸部署额外人力
items.summaryZh: 香港与深圳之间的皇岗口岸将于周一启用，香港保安局将启动紧急监察及支援中心以确保运作顺畅。当局已与深圳方面建立联合指挥中心，并将密切监控人流与车流情况。
items.whyImportant: 口岸的顺利启用对于促进深港两地的人员往来与物流效率至关重要。

items.title: Central retail shop bought by Swiss heir in ‘rare’ Hong Kong market move
items.summary: In a rare market move, a long-established local developer sold a Central retail shop that was held for over 50 years to an heir of Swiss underwear maker Triumph, according to data from the Land Registry, a deal analysts have called “highly unusual”. The use of international capital to acquire local retail assets in Hong Kong is uncommon. Triumph International did not immediately respond to a request for comment from the South China Morning Post. The transaction involved a ground-floor shop at...
items.titleZh: 瑞士内衣品牌继承人购入中环零售店，市场交易罕见
items.summaryZh: 香港一家长期持有的中环零售店被瑞士内衣品牌Triumph的继承人购入，该店此前已由本地开发商持有超过50年。分析人士指出，国际资本收购香港本地零售资产的情况并不常见。
items.whyImportant: 这笔罕见的交易反映了国际投资者对香港核心地段零售资产的关注。

items.title: Hong Kong rejects US downgrade to lowest tier in human trafficking report
items.summary: The United States has downgraded Hong Kong to the lowest tier in its annual human trafficking report, citing shortcomings in prosecutions and victim identification, an assessment the city’s government rejected as “entirely unfounded”. The US State Department’s 2026 Trafficking in Persons (TIP) Report, released on Thursday, moved Hong Kong from the Tier 2 Watch List, where it had been listed for two consecutive years, to Tier 3. That places the city alongside mainland China and Macau among 20...
items.titleZh: 香港拒绝接受美国人口贩运报告中的降级处理
items.summaryZh: 美国在2026年度人口贩运报告中将香港降至最低的第三级，理由是起诉和受害者识别方面存在不足。香港政府对此表示强烈反对，称该评估完全缺乏事实依据。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了美港之间在人权评估及国际声誉问题上的外交分歧。

items.title: Philippines thought Pogos were gone. Corruption and AI still power them
items.summary: Two years after the Philippines banned its notorious offshore gaming hubs, or Pogos, a recent crackdown on hundreds of foreigners has highlighted a worrying trend of embedded corruption that still enables the sector to thrive. In September, the National Bureau of Investigation raided a call centre-style facility in Makati City, arresting more than 120 Chinese nationals linked to an alleged illegal trading and a “lust scam” that tricked local and foreign victims into sharing explicit videos,...
items.titleZh: 菲律宾以为离岸博彩业（Pogo）已消失，但腐败与人工智能仍在助推其发展
items.summaryZh: 尽管菲律宾两年前已禁止离岸博彩中心，但近期对非法设施的突击检查显示，根深蒂固的腐败问题仍使该行业得以存续。执法部门近期逮捕了多名涉嫌参与非法交易及网络诈骗的外国公民。
items.whyImportant: 该事件揭示了监管禁令在应对跨境网络犯罪和腐败渗透方面的局限性。

items.title: US probes Harvard, Yale, MIT, other universities over alleged visa fraud, with China focus
items.summary: The Trump administration is launching an investigation into nine US universities over alleged J-1 visa fraud, with officials raising concerns about Chinese scholars and the Chinese government. The J-1 programme covers exchange visitors including international researchers, scholars and students, who may receive temporary authorisation to work or conduct research in the US. At a Thursday press conference, Anthony D’Esposito, inspector general of the US Department of Labor, announced what he called...
items.titleZh: 美国调查哈佛、耶鲁、麻省理工等大学涉嫌签证欺诈，重点关注中国相关问题
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府正对九所美国大学展开调查，指控其涉及J-1签证欺诈，并对中国学者及中国政府的角色表示担忧。J-1项目涵盖了在美进行研究或学习的国际交流人员。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国政府对学术交流领域的监管审查进一步收紧，可能影响中美学术合作。

items.title: Hong Kong needs tougher inspection regime, experts say after CK Asset building fiasco
items.summary: Lawmakers and engineering sector leaders have called for a review of Hong Kong’s building inspection mechanism and a blacklist to bar errant contractors from government tenders, after Hong Kong’s first privately built “starter homes” project hit a snag over shoddy steel work. The government should review the inspection regime and increase its supervisory manpower, lawmakers and engineers said on Friday, calling for inspectors to be stationed at construction sites of private-sector-built...
items.titleZh: 专家称香港需加强检查制度，此前长实楼盘出现建筑问题
items.summaryZh: 在香港首个私人参建“首置盘”项目出现钢筋工程质量问题后，立法会议员及工程界人士呼吁审查建筑检查机制。建议包括建立黑名单制度以限制违规承包商参与政府招标，并加强工地现场监管。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对私人住宅建筑质量监管力度及政府监督机制有效性的广泛关注。

items.title: Firmus pulls biggest ASX float since Telstra amid investor doubt about datacentre company
items.summary: The $11-a-share offer would have been the biggest debut on the stock market since the telecommunication giant in 1997 Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Firmus Technologies has scrapped what was set to be Australia’s biggest company listing in decades after investor demand for its much-hyped AI datacentre business failed to materialise. A Firmus spokesperson said the board decided that proceeding with the offer was no longer in the best interests of the company and its shareholders. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: Firmus取消自澳洲电信公司以来最大规模的澳交所上市计划，投资者对该数据中心公司存疑
items.summaryZh: 由于投资者对人工智能数据中心业务的需求不足，Firmus Technologies取消了原定成为澳洲数十年来最大规模的上市计划。公司董事会表示，继续推进该发行已不再符合公司及股东的最佳利益。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了市场对高估值人工智能基础设施项目投资热情的降温。

items.title: Houthis claim attack on Riyadh airport as airlines suspend flights to Saudi capital
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has not commented on claims, but confirmed three killed in airport strikes earlier this week Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis say they have struck Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh ⁠airport with a ballistic missile, badly damaging a plane and leading some airlines to suspend flights to the capital. The group provided no evidence, and Saudi Arabia did not immediately comment on the claim. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 胡塞武装声称袭击利雅得机场，多家航空公司暂停飞往沙特首都的航班
items.summaryZh: 也门胡塞武装宣称使用弹道导弹袭击了沙特利雅得机场，并造成飞机严重受损。沙特方面尚未对此置评，但部分航空公司已暂停相关航线。
items.whyImportant: 地区安全局势的升级直接影响了国际航空运输及中东地区的能源安全。

items.title: Iran war live: IRGC says it targets ‘violating’ ships nightly in Hormuz
items.summary: Iranian media reported massive explosions in the southern Strait of Hormuz, with Fars citing unnamed military sources.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称每晚在霍尔木兹海峡针对“违规”船只
items.summaryZh: 据伊朗媒体报道，霍尔木兹海峡南部发生大规模爆炸。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队声称其每晚都在该海域针对违规船只采取行动。
items.whyImportant: 霍尔木兹海峡作为全球能源运输要道，此类军事行动加剧了全球能源供应的不确定性。

items.title: Darfur: Healthcare needs outstrip resources as Security Council extends Sudan sanctions
items.summary: More than 700,000 displaced people in Tawila, in Sudan’s war-ravaged Darfur region, face severe shortages of healthcare, food, water and protection, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Thursday as it called for an urgent increase in resources.
items.titleZh: 达尔富尔：医疗需求超过资源，安理会延长对苏丹的制裁
items.summaryZh: 联合国世界卫生组织警告称，苏丹达尔富尔地区有超过70万流离失所者面临严重的医疗、食品和水资源短缺。安理会已决定延长对苏丹的制裁措施。
items.whyImportant: 苏丹持续的冲突导致的人道主义危机正处于极度恶化的边缘，亟需国际社会关注。

items.title: Trump says US will not attack Iran before November midterms
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said in a social media post that the US would “not be attacking Iran” before November’s midterm elections, citing what he said were “productive discussions” with the Islamic Republic. The president’s comments on Thursday amounted to an unusual blending of national security issues and domestic politics. His decision to lay off on new strikes comes despite Iran escalating attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran-backed militants in Yemen attacking energy...
items.titleZh: 特朗普称美国不会在11月中期选举前攻击伊朗
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在社交媒体上表示，由于与伊朗进行了“富有成效的讨论”，美国在11月中期选举前不会对伊朗发动攻击。此言论将国家安全议题与国内政治挂钩，引发关注。
items.whyImportant: 此表态显示了美国政府在处理中东紧张局势时，正试图平衡外交政策与国内选举压力。

items.title: Ethiopia launches drone attack against Eritrean troops who crossed into Tigray
items.summary: Government forces’ attack raises risk of internal conflict in Ethiopia that could trigger regional war Eritrean troops who crossed into Ethiopia’s Tigray region have come under drone attack from government forces, raising the risk that renewed internal conflict in Ethiopia could trigger an all-out regional war between the neighbouring countries. Military vehicles carrying soldiers drove across Eritrea’s southern border into Tigray on Wednesday, reaching the town of Adigrat 25 miles (40km) south, according to civilian witnesses, a militia commander and the conflict monitoring group Acled. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚对进入提格雷地区的厄立特里亚军队发动无人机袭击
items.summaryZh: 埃塞俄比亚政府军对越境进入提格雷地区的厄立特里亚军队发动了无人机袭击。据目击者和冲突监测组织称，厄方军事车辆已深入埃塞俄比亚境内，此举加剧了地区爆发全面战争的风险。
items.whyImportant: 此次冲突升级可能导致埃塞俄比亚内部局势恶化，并引发邻国间的全面战争。

items.title: Hong Kong police to launch international academy, reveal details of new degree
items.summary: Hong Kong’s police have revealed they will launch an academy offering specialised courses for overseas officers and shared new details about the force’s bachelor’s degree programme, with classes expected to start next March. Kelly Cheng Lai-ki, director of the Police College, said establishing the Hong Kong International Academy of Policing would consolidate generations of frontline wisdom handed down within the force into an international exchange hub. “These exchanges can showcase our...
items.titleZh: 香港警方将成立国际学院并公布新学位课程详情
items.summaryZh: 香港警队宣布将成立香港国际警务学院，旨在为海外警务人员提供专业课程，并打造国际交流枢纽。该学院的学士学位课程预计将于明年三月开课。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过国际交流提升香港警队的专业影响力，并整合警队内部的实战经验。

items.title: Hegseth says firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be ‘public’
items.summary: Nidal Hasan, army psychiatrist who killed 13 people, will be executed by firing squad on 3 December Pete Hegseth has said the execution of Nidal Hasan, the former army psychiatrist who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, will be a public event when the sentence is carried out later this year. A defense department official later confirmed the execution will be livestreamed. In an interview with Real America’s Voice, the Pentagon secretary said the firing squad will carry out the sentence at Fort Hood, Texas, at 1pm on Thursday, 3 December. This would be the first US military execution in more than 60 years. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 赫格塞斯称胡德堡枪击案凶手的行刑将公开进行
items.summaryZh: 美国国防部长赫格塞斯表示，曾于胡德堡枪击案中杀害13人的前陆军精神科医生尼达尔·哈桑，将于12月3日接受行刑队处决。国防部官员确认，此次处决过程将进行直播。
items.whyImportant: 这将是美国六十多年来首次执行军事死刑，且以公开直播形式进行，引发了广泛关注。

items.title: US to live-stream firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan
items.summary: The US will live-stream the US Army’s coming firing squad execution of a gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, the Pentagon said, in what would be an unprecedented broadcast of a US execution. Nidal Hasan, a former US Army psychiatrist, is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945. The execution is scheduled for December 3 at the same sprawling Texas base where Hasan opened fire with a laser-sighted handgun in ‌a...
items.titleZh: 美国将直播胡德堡枪击案凶手尼达尔·哈桑的行刑过程
items.summaryZh: 五角大楼宣布，美国军方将直播对2009年胡德堡基地枪击案凶手尼达尔·哈桑的枪决。这将是自1945年以来美国军方首次执行枪决，也是美国历史上首次公开直播死刑执行。
items.whyImportant: 此举打破了美国死刑执行的传统惯例，引发了关于司法透明度与伦理的广泛讨论。

items.title: NASA, Energy Department Advance New Era of Nuclear-Powered Exploration
items.summary: Editor’s note: This release was updated Oct. 8, 2026 with the formal name of the summit. As the Golden Age of deep-space exploration begins, NASA and the U.S. Department of Energy are advancing the development of safe, reliable, next-generation nuclear technologies for space. Together, the agencies will supercharge civil space exploration, unlock bold scientific discovery, […]
items.titleZh: NASA与能源部共同推进核动力太空探索新时代
items.summaryZh: 随着深空探索进入黄金时代，NASA与美国能源部正合作开发用于太空任务的安全、可靠的下一代核技术。双方旨在通过此举增强民用太空探索能力，并推动重大的科学发现。
items.whyImportant: 核动力技术的应用将显著提升人类在深空探测任务中的能源效率与续航能力。

items.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
items.summary: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".
items.titleZh: 五角大楼称将直播枪决过程
items.summaryZh: 皮特·赫格塞斯表示此次行刑将公开进行，但法律专家指出这一“史无前例”的决定处于法律灰色地带。该事件因其公开性引发了关于法律程序正当性的争议。
items.whyImportant: 该决定在法律界引发了关于死刑执行公开化是否符合宪法及法律程序的激烈辩论。

items.title: US Senate candidate fires back after Trump misnames him ‘Mohammed’
items.summary: A Muslim candidate for US Senate accused Donald Trump of “struggling” on Thursday after the president misnamed him “Mohammed” on social media amid increasingly bitter exchanges between the two men. Trump attacked the left-wing Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed on his Truth Social platform, baselessly accusing him of being a “Terrorist Sympathizer”. El-Sayed, an Arab-American running for a Michigan senate seat that could decide which party wins the US upper chamber in knife-edge midterm...
items.titleZh: 美国参议院候选人回击特朗普对其“穆罕默德”的错误称呼
items.summaryZh: 美国参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德指责特朗普在社交媒体上将其错误地称为“穆罕默德”，并反驳了特朗普对其“恐怖分子同情者”的无端指控。作为密歇根州参议院席位的竞争者，埃尔-赛义德正处于两党争夺参议院控制权的关键选战中。
items.whyImportant: 此事件反映了美国政治极化背景下，针对少数族裔候选人的言论攻击已成为选战中的敏感议题。

items.title: What is the Mecca defence pact?
items.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan are activating their defence pact to counter attacks from Yemen’s Houthis.
items.titleZh: 什么是麦加防御条约？
items.summaryZh: 沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和巴基斯坦正在启动其防御条约，以应对来自也门胡塞武装的袭击。该条约旨在加强三国在面对地区安全威胁时的协同防御能力。
items.whyImportant: 该防御条约的激活标志着中东及周边地区在应对胡塞武装威胁方面形成了新的安全协作机制。

items.title: 1 dead in Poland’s second school knife attack in 2 days, amid ‘copycat’ fears
items.summary: A 15-year-old former pupil killed one employee and injured two others at a Polish primary school on Thursday wearing a helmet-mounted camera, the second school stabbing in two days, possibly in response to an internet challenge, authorities said. A 37-year-old woman who ‌worked as a caretaker had died in the latest attack, which took place at around 9am local time in Leszczydol-Nowiny, northeast of Warsaw, officials said. On Wednesday, a 19-year-old wounded 10 people including himself at another...
items.titleZh: 波兰两天内发生第二起校园持刀袭击事件，造成1人死亡，引发“模仿犯罪”担忧
items.summaryZh: 波兰一所小学发生持刀袭击，一名15岁前学生造成1名员工死亡、2人受伤，袭击者作案时佩戴了头盔摄像头。这是波兰两天内发生的第二起校园袭击，当局担心这可能与网络挑战有关。
items.whyImportant: 连续发生的校园暴力事件引发了波兰社会对青少年心理健康及网络不良信息诱导犯罪的深切担忧。

items.title: Did a US warship lose power while chasing a Chinese destroyer in the South China Sea?
items.summary: The Chinese navy says it had a rare South China Sea encounter involving a foreign warship that lost power, propulsion and radar while following a People’s Liberation Army destroyer, an account that resembles incidents this year involving US Navy destroyers in the region. The incident occurred when a foreign vessel conducted aggressive close shadowing of the PLA Navy Type 055 destroyer Zunyi during routine training by the Chinese vessel, state broadcaster CCTV reported on Wednesday. The CCTV...
items.titleZh: 美国军舰在南海追踪中国驱逐舰时是否发生动力故障？
items.summaryZh: 中国海军称，一艘外国军舰在近距离跟踪中国海军055型驱逐舰“遵义”号时，出现了动力、推进系统和雷达故障。中方称该外国舰艇在演习期间进行了挑衅性的近距离跟踪。
items.whyImportant: 此类海上近距离接触事件增加了中美在南海地区发生误判或冲突的风险。
